branchName.instructions: Use type/short-kebab-slug, e.g. feat/task-tree, fix/wsl-daemon-start, docs/adr-0026. Types: feat, fix, docs, test, chore, ci, refactor.

commitMessage.instructions: Conventional Commits: type(scope): imperative summary under ~72 chars, then a short body explaining why. Scopes follow the area (web, desktop, cli, runs, wsapi, store, ...).

pullRequest.instructions: Title in Conventional Commits form (it drives release-please). Body: what changed, how it was verified (commands + screenshots for UI), what is NOT verified, and decisions not covered by the spec. Base branch: develop. Never stack PRs.
